home.title: Sign in once, prove every platform
home.statement: CP OAuth is an OAuth 2.0 provider for competitive programmers. Link and verify your Luogu, AtCoder, LeetCode, Codeforces and other accounts, then let apps read exactly the identities you approve.

about.title: About CP OAuth
about.description: How accounts are verified and how an app signs users in.
about.platformsText: Every linked account is verified before it is saved.
about.providerSignIn: Verified by signing in with the provider.

proof.luogu: Verified with a code placed in a public Luogu clipboard.
proof.atcoder: Verified with a code placed in the AtCoder profile Affiliation field.
proof.leetcode: Verified with a code placed in the leetcode.cn profile bio.

about.flowText: Standard OAuth 2.0 with optional PKCE (S256 or plain).

steps.register: Register a client in the developer console and add its exact redirect URIs.
steps.redirect: Send the user to the authorization endpoint with client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code, scope, state and, for public clients, a PKCE code_challenge.
steps.consent: The user signs in and approves the requested scopes. The browser returns to your redirect URI with a code valid for 10 minutes.
steps.exchange: Exchange the code at the token endpoint for an access token (1 hour) and a refresh token (30 days).
steps.userinfo: Call the userinfo endpoint with the bearer access token. Claims are limited to the granted scopes.
steps.refresh: Use the refresh token to get new tokens. Each refresh token works once and is replaced on use.

about.scopesText: Apps request scopes; users see each one on the consent screen.
